# Chapter 2: Probability 

## Part A — Asking the right data question
### 2.1 What is data science actually doing?

$$\text{conversion rate}=\frac{\text{buyers}}{\text{visitors}}$$

```{r}
visitors <- 400
buyers <- 40
rate <- buyers/visitors
c(rate=rate,percent=100*rate)
```

### 2.2 Populations, samples and the risk of bias
$$\text{sample fraction}=\frac{n}{N}$$

```{r}
sample_size <- 200; population <- 10000
100*sample_size/population
```
